ns2:course.label: National Security Studies I
ns2:course.description: Study of the Armed Forces as an integral element in contemporary society with specific emphasis on the military profession, civil-military interaction, and the formulation, organization, and implementation of U. S. national security policy. In addition, students study leadership and management, ethical decision making, and communication skills. Requires concurrent enrollment with AFAS 102. Prerequisite: AFAS 332 or consent of instructor.
